modifications: Normalize CRLF and final blank lines only; preserve original instructions, restoration annotations and license notices.

selector.note: Upstream reconstruction selector, not independently verified original build date.

case_note: /MX preserves PUBLIC/EXTRN symbol spelling to bind directly to the independently verified C engine. This changes object symbol metadata, not instruction encoding.
frame_note: Native F0/T0 and F2/T2 with identical indices specify the same frame as F5. The verifier accepts only this equality and checks every resulting byte and LE target fixup; no fixups are rewritten or masked.
build_note: No prebuilt engine objects or instruction-byte dumps enter reconstructed output.
